description: This Java class defines a custom data type handling for Blob objects in PostgreSQL within the Liquibase database migration framework. It maps the 'longblob' type to 'oid' in PostgreSQL for consistency with Hibernate ORM, overriding default behavior and providing specific database type mapping and priorities.

classes.name: PostgreSQLBlobType
classes.description: A custom Blob data type class for PostgreSQL that maps 'longblob' to the 'oid' type, ensuring consistency with Hibernate ORM and overriding default Liquibase behavior.

methods.name: toDatabaseDataType
methods.description: Maps the blob type to 'OID' for PostgreSQL databases; delegates to superclass for other databases.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this data type, slightly higher than the superclass.
